description: Register a SegmentResource under a resource key. Holds Segment HTTP API auth (HTTP Basic write_key) and exposes batch_ops (POST /v1/batch — identify/track/page/screen/group/alias, payload auto-packed to Segment's 500KB limit) for downstream Segment sinks.

write_key_env_var.label: Write Key Env Var
write_key_env_var.description: Tracking API (HTTP Basic), used by dataframe_to_segment and other Tracking-API sinks.

access_token_env_var.label: Access Token Env Var
access_token_env_var.description: Config API (Bearer auth) -- a different credential from write_key_env_var. Set this if segment_ingestion (or another Config-API component) will use this resource via resource_key.

name: Segment Resource
